name: Young Actors Summer Institute (YASI)
description_short: Trinity Rep's Young Actors Summer Institute: one-week summer theater camps, each on a different topic (musical theater, improv and comedy, fight and make-up, one acts and more), for students from first grade through recent high school graduates, led by local artists and educators. Take one week or mix and match several.
activities: Stage combat and stage make-up (YASI Fight & Make-Up)
refund_policy_summary: $50 non-refundable deposit to hold a spot. Full refund (less deposit and registration fees) if cancelled at least one week before the first day; 50% of tuition for later cancellations before the first session; no refund once the camp begins.

sources.note: YASI page: 'See you in 2027!'; no 2027 dates, prices or camp list posted; address and phone are Trinity Rep's theater and offices
